Method of Attack: covert remote access and data exfiltration through Gmail
using hardcoded Gmail credentials to log into the service's SMTP server (smpt.gmail.com)
sending reconnaissance information to allow the attacker to remotely access the compromised system
connecting to a remote server using WebSocket over SSL
receiving tunnel configuration instructions to establish a persistent, encrypted, bidirectional tunnel from the host to the attacker
forwarding traffic from the remote host to the local system through the tunnel
allowing internal admin panel and API access, file transfer, email exfiltration, shell command execution, credentials harvesting, and lateral movement
